summary: Iter10 — verified the 3 UI fixes + backend support: (1) Expenses CRUD with linked wallet-ledger reversal/recreation, (2) OxaPay ledger schema exposes original_coin/original_amount, (3) Treasury merged feed page reachable and OxaPay sync-history endpoint working. Backend pytest 7/7 PASS; Frontend Playwright covers Add/Edit modal title switch, prefilled form, PATCH on save, trash → DELETE with toast 'Expense deleted and wallet ledger reversed'. Cron @EVERY_30_MINUTES is registered (ScheduleModule + WebhooksModule initialized in NestJS startup log).
critical_code_review_comments: Treasury.jsx is 1498 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting OKX/Binance/AED/Wio tab bodies into their own tab components to reduce cognitive load (non-blocking).

WalletLedger original_coin / original_amount column is only meaningful for OxaPay deposits today. Other wallets show fallback to converted coin which is correct, but consider extracting the isOxaDeposit logic into a row formatter so the same shape can be reused if Binance/OKX adopts native-coin display later.
Expenses.jsx delete flow uses window.confirm; consider replacing with the existing AlertDialog component for visual consistency (non-blocking).
seed_data_creation: Created+deleted TEST_Vendor_<uuid> and one expense per pytest test; created TEST_UI_Vendor + expense for UI run then deleted both. DB left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PostgreSQL is fresh — no live OxaPay rows exist. The schema check (original_coin / original_amount present on ledger row) passes vacuously when the list is empty; the test guards with `if rows`. To stress the actual OxaPay column rendering visually, seed a wallet_ledger row with wallet='OXAPAY', tx_type='deposit', coin='USDT', network='Bitcoin Network', original_coin='BTC', original_amount='0.00156404', amount='116.50913146' then load /wallets → OXAPAY tab. NestJS proxy lives at 127.0.0.1:9001; FastAPI shim on 8001 just forwards /api/*.
rca of the issue: n/a — all reported bugs from main agent verified fixed.
